caption: The worked example of one query over two keys: the scores 1 and 0 are divided by √2 and softmaxed into weights 0.670 and 0.330. Those weights sum to 1, so the output [0.670, 1.000] is a mix of the two value rows.

spec.title: Worked example: one query, two keys, dk = 2
spec.aria: Scaled dot-product attention for one query: q1 dot k1 gives 1 and q1 dot k2 gives 0, dividing by root 2 gives 0.707 and 0, softmax gives weights 0.670 and 0.330, and the weighted sum of the value rows gives the output 0.670 and 1.000.
